# Phrasing conventions — weekly-payment-run

- The ACH file is "the ACH file — a NACHA file"; thereafter "the NACHA file" or "the ACH batch".
- Chase Connect named in full; do not use the colloquial "the portal" in procedure prose.
- Bank release wording: "released by the Corporate Controller or, in the Controller's absence, the Treasury Analyst".
- Weekly volumes phrased as ranges: "four to six hundred lines", "$2,000,000 to $2,500,000".
- Prior SOP cites as "§7.2 of the prior SOP, SRC-006" (matches non-po convention).
